content_record.title: Bone Marrow Fat Secretes Lipids That Drive Cellular Senescence—and a Targeted Framework May Stop It
content_record.editorial_body: New research reveals that bone marrow adipocytes flood neighboring cells with lipids, triggering mitochondrial dysfunction and senescence. A polycation-loaded framework interrupts this lipid crosstalk, restoring osteogenesis. Bone marrow adipocytes secrete lipids that impair mitochondrial function in neighboring cells. A biomimetic framework (CZP@LC) blocks lipid synthesis and secretion, preventing senescence. Interrupting lipid communication rescues osteoblasts and restores bone formation. This signal is based on Remodeling adipocytes' lipid metabolism with a polycation loaded enzyme-active framework reverses osteoporotic bone marrow. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
